falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on 5100 as structural support; a break below 4950 invalidates the V-bottom recovery structure and confirms distribution rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX spike-and-collapse; sustained elevated fear indicates this is not a similar capitulation-and-recovery but rather an ongoing risk-off regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX is simultaneously below 5200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals flight-to-safety with equity weakness, breaking the pattern's required macro setup where yields and equities stabilized together; indicates recession pricing rather than soft-landing bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
